label: HSC-associated regulation
interpretation: Hlf, Mecom, Procr and Ly6a support an HSC-associated regulatory/marker mixture within the pooled HSPC compartment.
boundary: Not a purified HSC identity, measured quiescence, self-renewal assay, or a new HSC/MPP subdivision. Adgrl4 and Nrxn1 contribute strongly and the spectrum is mixed.

label: Biosynthesis / metabolism
additional_genes: Fabp5; Dbi; Nme1; Cycs; Srm; Rpl11; Rps15a
interpretation: Ribosomal/RNA-processing genes occur together with lipid/isoprenoid and respiratory-metabolic machinery; this is a broad biosynthetic/metabolic component.
boundary: Not a lineage-specific program or evidence of greater translation, respiration, or metabolic flux. Ndufa4 is assigned to respiratory complex IV, not complex I.

label: G2/M mitosis
additional_genes: Nusap1; Cenpa; Tpx2; Birc5; Cdc20; Plk1; Aurka
interpretation: A coherent mitotic/spindle/chromosome-segregation component, consistent with the existing G2-M Checkpoint annotation.
boundary: Program usage is not a measured division rate and does not identify lineage output or self-renewal.

label: Integrated stress response
additional_genes: Atf5; Nupr1; Ddit3; Chac1; Slc7a11; Ppp1r15a; Herpud1
interpretation: ATF4-associated amino-acid, redox and proteostasis response genes provide a more specific description than the generic cellular-stimuli term.
boundary: A transcriptional stress-associated mixture, not a direct assay of eIF2alpha phosphorylation, ATF4 protein activity, stress cause, injury, or inferior stem-cell function; ISR can support HSC persistence.

label: CDK6 / immune-associated
additional_genes: Tespa1; Lat2; Fcer1g; Clec4e; Cpa3; Gzmb; Itga2b
interpretation: Cdk6 and Cd48 place the component in a progenitor-activation context, accompanied by immune-signaling/granule genes spanning more than one mature lineage.
boundary: Mixed program: not platelet identity, NK-cell identity, proven quiescence exit, or a specific commitment route. Cdk6 RNA does not establish CDK6 protein or kinase activity.

label: DNA replication / repair
additional_genes: Pcna; Tk1; Rrm2; Lig1; Rad51ap1; Hells; Gmnn; Tyms
interpretation: Replication licensing/synthesis and homologous-recombination-associated genes distinguish this component from the predominantly mitotic P3 program; consistent with existing E2F Targets annotation.
boundary: Not evidence of DNA damage, mutation burden, measured repair activity, or greater cell-division rate.

label: Glycolysis / hypoxia-associated
additional_genes: Eno1; Tpi1; Aldoa; Aldoc; Bhlhe40; Ankrd37; Csf3r; Prtn3
interpretation: A coherent glycolytic and hypoxia-response-associated core occurs with immediate-early and some myeloid-associated genes.
boundary: Not measured oxygen tension, glycolytic flux, or a causal driver of faster differentiation. Glycolysis can also support HSC quiescence; the myeloid genes do not establish a pure granulocytic program.

label: HSPC regulation / adhesion
additional_genes: Med12l; Runx1; Mecom; Ncam2; Enah; Itga6; Slamf1; Palld
interpretation: Hematopoietic regulatory genes coexist with receptors, adhesion and cytoskeletal genes; this provides an HSPC-relevant description of a mixed component.
boundary: Not neuronal fate, a pure HSC identity, proven TGF-beta pathway activity, measured adhesion, or self-renewal. MED12L is not MED12; Ncam2 alone does not establish a hematopoietic mechanism.
